requirements: UC-01 through UC-10, finite OptionB milestone only
hypothesis: One small audio-to-complete-command classifier with treated human supervision, human-majority sampling and variable silence context can remove independent auxiliary-head disagreement without unsafe keyword or gate bypasses.

architecture.output: one atomic 32-way complete-command or UNKNOWN head
architecture.initialization: random, seed 53; no pretrained acoustic encoder, teacher or CTC

sources.reference_policy: existing admitted frozen typed references; no automatic relabeling or new listening claims

data_rules.out_of_optionb_valid_commands: explicit task negatives; original expected command retained
data_rules.ambiguous_references: never fit and never score as UNKNOWN
data_rules.evaluation_membership: unchanged; holdout/test metadata used only for leakage checks before selection, not fitting

frontend.features: 40-bin causal HTK log-mel, 16kHz, 25ms window, 10ms hop; fresh deterministic extraction with BLAS threads 1
frontend.normalization: new equal-utterance global statistics from exactly admitted unique human TRAIN only; train/inference matched
frontend.raw_audio: read only; no cropping, splicing, new downloads or copied payloads
frontend.derived_arrays: RAM only, tensor hashes recorded before first optimizer step

sampling.positive_balance: complete-command class then declared speaker then recording
sampling.negative_balance: true UNKNOWN versus outside-OptionB then declared speaker then recording

augmentation.context: 0 to 1.2 seconds floor-valued feature context at each end with probability .65; all original frames retained
augmentation.channel_gain: all synthetic, .7 of humans; smooth per-frequency log-energy perturbation plus scalar gain
augmentation.other: small normalized feature jitter and at most four frequency bins masked; no time cropping or word/negation removal
augmentation.not_claimed: real reverberation, unrelated spoken-word resilience, acoustic source ablation or live VAD qualification

selection.weights: mixed epochs only; maximize human development complete-command raw micro-F1, then precision, then synthetic development recall; no test/holdout access
selection.policy: one global joint-command posterior and margin grid; select on human dev/calibration only
selection.policy_feasibility: precision >= .99 and negative false-accept rate <= .01 in EACH human dev/calibration cohort, with at least one true accept per cohort; otherwise disable
selection.policy_rank: maximize minimum dev/cal recall, then mean recall, then stricter probability and margin
selection.research_quality_target: at least .90 complete-command recall at .99 precision and <=.01 negative false-accept rate; missing human cell coverage and exposed evaluation still prevent qualification

final_evaluation.comparison: prior OptionB frozen full model: raw 79/80, correct accepted 39/80, FP 0/14, recall .4875, F1 .6554621848739496
final_evaluation.not_blind: historically exposed test/holdout; regression evidence only

outputs.preserve: all prior 289 bindings, installed and submission models, policies, publisher inputs and source map

deployment_status: Research only; no publish, installation, microphone operation, commit, external request or physical actuation. Complete-command output mapping is not proof of live device success.
